## Description

Please include a summary of the change, the problem it solves, and the context.

Fixes # (issue reference number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring/Code cleanup (no logic changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing

### Backend Jest Tests
- [ ] I have verified that all existing backend tests pass (`npm test` in the `server` directory).
- [ ] I have written new unit/integration tests for my changes (if applicable).

### Frontend Production Build
- [ ] I have verified that the frontend builds successfully (`npm run build` in the `client` directory) without warnings or errors.

## Security & Quality Checklist

- [ ] My changes do not expose any API keys, credentials, JWT secrets, or connection strings.
- [ ] I have verified that `.env` is not modified/committed.
- [ ] No local logs, temporary files, or dependencies outside `package.json` are committed.
